user.title: Choose a library
user.description: Search the nearby results, or enter the library's exact LocationID manually. The provider list may be incomplete.

library_manual.title: Find a library
library_manual.description: Enter the exact Solus LocationID supplied by your library. This is not a library name search.

credentials.title: Library account
credentials.description: Enter your card number and PIN. Home Assistant stores the PIN in the config entry. One entry represents one library and card.

reauth_confirm.title: Update library PIN
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the new PIN for this library account. The stored card and device identity are retained.

reconfigure.title: Update library PIN
reconfigure.description: Enter the PIN for this entry's library card. Add another integration entry to use a different card or library.

error.invalid_auth: The library rejected the credentials. Check your card number and PIN. Reference: {reference}.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to contact or interpret the library provider. Try again later. Reference: {reference}.

abort.already_configured: This library and card are already configured.

renew_loan.name: Renew loan
renew_loan.description: Explicitly renew one loan in the selected account. Review any fee or provider prompt before confirming. Requires control permission for an Axiell Libraries entity in the selected account.

config_entry_id.name: Library account
config_entry_id.description: Select the library and card entry that owns the loan.

loan_id.name: Loan ID
loan_id.description: Copy loan_id from the Active loans sensor's loans attribute. This is not record_id.

confirm.name: Confirm reviewed prompt
confirm.description: Enable only after reviewing the message associated with this confirmation ID.

confirmation_id.name: Confirmation ID
confirmation_id.description: Use the local ID returned for this account and loan; expires after ten minutes and on reload.

invalid_confirmation.message: Request renewal again for a new confirmation, then supply both confirm: true and its confirmation_id.

loan_not_found.message: This loan is no longer in the selected account.

not_renewable.message: This loan cannot currently be renewed.

missing_source.message: The library did not identify this loan's source.

loan_changed.message: The loan changed. Request renewal again to review new consent.

confirmation_limit.message: The library returned repeated or too many consent prompts. Check with the library.

authentication_failed.message: Authentication failed. Reauthenticate the selected library account.

refresh_failed.message: Unable to read current loans. No renewal was attempted.

outcome_unknown.message: Renewal outcome is unknown. Check the loan with your library before retrying. Renewal was not automatically repeated.

entry_closing.message: The library account is unloading. Try again once it is loaded.

confirmation_required.message: {message} Review this prompt before confirming. Call renew_loan again with the same account and loan, confirm: true and confirmation_id: {confirmation_id} within {expires_in} seconds.

renewed_refresh_failed.message: The loan was renewed, but Home Assistant could not refresh. Use Update entity to refresh loans; do not repeat renewal solely to update Home Assistant.
